messages.subject: For Luke Miels | Global healthcare, government relations and regulatory stakeholder strategy
messages.body:
Dear GSK Investor Relations Team,

Please place this executive introduction before Mr. Luke Miels, Chief Executive Officer.

GSK's global medicines and vaccines platform depends on disciplined alignment across governments, regulators, health systems, communities and major investment priorities. That interface closely matches my current leadership mandate.

I serve as Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department at AGM Inc., part of Zijin Mining Group. My responsibilities span government and regulatory relations, ESG, corporate affairs, strategic partnerships and executive advisory, with senior institutional engagement across complex regulated operations.

I would welcome a senior discussion about where this combination of government relations, regulatory strategy and emerging-market stakeholder execution might support GSK's priorities. My attached CV has been tailored specifically to GSK.

Kind regards,
Ragunauth Ramsaroop
Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department | AGM Inc.
ragunauthramsaroop@icloud.com
